page.overview:
Who is Alfredo Landi Naddeo?

Alfredo Landi Naddeo was an obese Tilean merchant who escaped from the fury of his customers by sacrificing his assistant Mercy Oriontale.

His next shop in Piacanca Plaza was simply named Alfredo's. The place is like a cavern, crammed with goods. The light is poor, and the air is thick with dust. The ceiling is low, and hanging from it there are hundreds of ornate helmets, many displaying puncture marks that he doubted any wearer could have survived.

Additionally, every inch of the wall and most of the floor is covered with wares. There are vicious-looking axes, their edges' serrated teeth ready to bite. There are parchments, cauldrons, caskets, gowns, pikes, and pantaloons, as well as skulls, leg bones, pickled limbs in jars, and pickled things in jars.

But the most impressive piece is the magic sword of Lord Mobach, a blade that will not harm any man who speaks the truth, and, as a bonus, will bring a life of virtue to whomever owns it.
